notes: The catalogue gives the date as VS 1813, but the colophon reads saṃvat 1913. VS 1813 is probably a catalogue typo. The colophon names the era only as 'saṃvat'. VS is assumed because the script is Devanagari and the four-digit year fits VS. Pauṣa kṛṣṇa 10 of VS 1913 falls around Dec 1856 or early Jan 1857, depending on the month system (amānta or pūrṇimānta).
